notes: Paired scenario fixtures (Plan §10.1-§10.2). Each PAIR shares one source and
one sidecar, and differs only in the target tab — so a difference in the
advisories is a difference in the ARRANGEMENT, never in the inputs.
Expectations are stated as advisory CODES, never as prose (Plan §6.3), so the
wording of a message stays free to improve. `advisoriesAbsent` is the half
that matters most: it is where a false positive gets caught.
Paths are relative to tools/fixtures/. The runner is

scenarios.name: jazz-shell-positive
scenarios.intent: Shell voicings keep the 3rd and 7th of every chord. A jazz arranger did the jazz thing; nothing should complain.

scenarios.name: jazz-flattened-negative
scenarios.intent: The same ii-V-I-VI reduced to bare power chords. Root motion is still correct, so the HARD gate passes — and eight consecutive harmonies lose their identity, which is exactly what the soft signal is for.

scenarios.name: jazz-flattened-under-metal
scenarios.intent: Calibration: the SAME flattened tab under metal. Sustained root-fifth writing is the genre, so the colour analyzer is off entirely. Changing the style must remove irrelevant advice.

scenarios.name: metal-riff-positive
scenarios.intent: A palm-muted root pedal with power-chord stabs: the reduction a metal arranger would actually write. Omitted thirds are correct here and must draw no criticism.

scenarios.name: metal-literal-negative
scenarios.intent: The same chords typed onto the guitar unchanged — piano writing with a pick. Low thirds under high gain, no riff, no mute, no pedal.

scenarios.name: blues-lead-positive
scenarios.intent: A pentatonic lead with bends, slides, vibrato and a repeating call. Blues weights articulation heavily, and this passage is made of it.

scenarios.name: blues-literal-negative
scenarios.intent: The same dominant chords transcribed rigidly: no bend, no slide, no vibrato, no phrasing. Every expressive marker the style is built on is absent.

scenarios.name: role-aware-correct
scenarios.intent: Dual guitar: the melody lives only in the lead track, the roots only in the rhythm track, and both parts are independently playable.

scenarios.name: role-aware-swapped
scenarios.intent: The same two tracks with the roles declared backwards. The melody is still SOMEWHERE in the score, and the aggregate view would happily pass it — the whole point of roles is that this must fail.

scenarios.name: sidecar-responsible
scenarios.intent: Every tab bar is tied to the source. A responsibly mapped arrangement draws no proportion advice.

scenarios.name: sidecar-excessively-free
scenarios.intent: Half the tab is declared free. The map is entirely VALID and the gate passes — the advisory asks whether that much added material is intended, and does not accuse anyone of evading anything.
